Codex takes its shell from the passwd record and exposes no override, so this cannot be configured away. Guidance is documented at ~/.claude-shared/rules/shell-footguns.md; use rc/exit_code and repo_path/p instead.

wontfix-interceptor; native recipe documented instead. These asked for an rg wrapper or an argv-safe search helper. A transparent wrapper makes every agent run a non-standard rg that diverges from the documented tool, and the machine-wide rm block was deleted on 2026-07-26 for exactly that shape of failure. The mechanical fix already exists in ripgrep: `printf %s\n 'the$pattern' | rg -f - -- path/` reads patterns from stdin so the shell never parses them, which handles quotes, backticks, $, leading dashes and embedded newlines in one form. Added to ~/.claude-shared/rules/shell-footguns.md. Demonstrated live: `rg -c '--json' src/cli.rs` consumes --json as a FLAG, treats the filename as the pattern, searches the whole repo and returns confident wrong results with exit 0 — it does not error, it lies. The -f - form reports correctly. Reversible: if telemetry shows agents still fail with the recipe available, an opt-in named helper (never a transparent rg replacement) is the escalation.
